title: Trial exhibits (video/audio) – State of Florida v. Steven Matthew Wolf, Michelle Osborne homicide

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Florida Sunshine Law, I hereby request the following records:

Records from the prosecution of State of Florida v. Steven Matthew Wolf (Monroe County Circuit Court; Florida Supreme Court Case No. SC2023-1077) for the November 2018 homicide of Michelle Rena Osborne in Marathon, FL. Mr. Wolf was convicted by a jury in January 2023, and the Florida Supreme Court affirmed the conviction and sentence on direct appeal.

1. All video and audio recordings introduced or marked as exhibits at trial or at the penalty phase, including but not limited to:
   a. Body-worn camera and dash camera footage recorded by Monroe County Sheriff's Office deputies.
   b. Video and audio recordings of all law enforcement interviews of Steven Matthew Wolf.
   c. Surveillance or other video depicting Mr. Wolf's van.
   d. 911 or dispatch recordings.
2. The State's exhibit list(s) for the trial and the penalty phase.

I request unedited native video and audio files. If any portion is withheld, please release all segregable portions and cite the specific statutory exemption for each redaction.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Andrea Iorio

title: Bodycam & interview video – Aaron Glee Jr. homicide investigation (Salau/Sims), June 2020

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Florida Sunshine Law, I hereby request the following records:

Records related to the Tallahassee Police Department investigation into the disappearance and homicides of Oluwatoyin "Toyin" Salau (19) and Victoria "Vicki" Sims (75), June 6–14, 2020. The suspect, Aaron Lee Glee Jr., pleaded guilty and was sentenced on September 22, 2023, so the case is closed.

1. All body-worn camera footage recorded by TPD officers from June 11 to June 14, 2020 in connection with the missing persons reports for Ms. Sims and Ms. Salau, including the search of Aaron Glee Jr.'s residence and the surrounding wooded area on June 13, 2020.
2. Video and audio recordings of all interviews of Aaron Lee Glee Jr. conducted by TPD.
3. Dash camera footage from the same incidents.
